camel_example: aliyun ice QuerySearchIndex --region cn-hangzhou --IndexType mm --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the details of a specific type of index in a specified search library, including the index status and the number of associated media assets
description_zh: 查询指定搜索库中某类索引的详情，包括索引状态和关联媒资数量
name: QuerySearchIndex

parameters.help_en:
The name of the search library.
If you do not specify a search library name, the search index is created in the default search library of IMS by default. Default value: ims-default-search-lib.
You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html operation to query existing search libraries
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库名称。
未填写搜索库名称时，默认情况下搜索索引会被创建在IMS的默认搜索库下。默认值ims-default-search-lib。
您还可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html接口查询已有的搜索库信息
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
